pages.text: $(l)Military → Honours$() ranks your 10 best recruits by $(l)merit$(): kills, damage, raids defended or won, Royal Guard duty and staying alive. Merit fades about 15% a day, so the board shows who is in form now.

A recruit with merit 60+ may $(l)ask for gear$(): their favourite weapon, or better armour when theirs lags behind what your town can make. Up to 3 requests at once.$(li)$(l)Grant$(): equip it from the stockpile (+morale)$(li)$(l)Order$(): the smithy forges it$(li)$(l)Decline$() (-morale)
